p5.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/metropolitan-park-workforce-enhancement-job-opportunities
p5.excerpt: Hard Rock believes promoting from within benefits the company and the employees, and it strives to offer a stable and long-term career path for each employee. Thus, Hard Rock Metropolitan Park will assist employees with access to promotion opportunities and will establish transparent career paths with measurable criteria leading to increased responsibility and higher pay grades designed to allow and encourage employees to pursue career advancement within the company. The company workforce training programs also include opportunities for employee access to additional resources, such as tuition reimbursement, that will enable employees to acquire education or job training needed to advance their career paths through increased responsibility and paygrades.
